name: mosfet-2n7002
description: JSCJ 2N7002 N-channel MOSFET, 60 V, 115 mA, Vgs(th) 1-2.5 V, SOT-23 pins 1=G 2=S 3=D (LCSC C8545, JLCPCB basic)

spice.model: .model MOS_2N7002 NMOS(LEVEL=1 VTO=1.6 KP=0.06 LAMBDA=0.02 RD=1 RS=0.5 CGSO=20p CGDO=5p)

metadata.rotation_note: JLCPCB's SOT-23 reel orientation is 90 degrees clockwise from this footprint: their preview on the mug order (2026-09-08) at offset 0 showed the two-lead side on top where the footprint has it on the right, with the pin-1 dot at top-right where pad 1 sits at bottom-right. Offset 270 turns the part clockwise by 90 so both line up: pins 1 (G) and 2 (S) on the footprint's pads 1 and 2, pin 3 (D) on pad 3.
